2610.05681.title: Automatic Speech Recognition for Low-Resource Sinhala: A Critical Review of Methods, Challenges, and Future Directions
2610.05681.paper_summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) for low-resource languages remains a major challenge. Sinhala, the primary language of Sri Lanka with about 16 million speakers, illustrates the difficulty: agglutinative morphology, a 54-phoneme inventory, subject-object-verb (SOV) syntax and scarce annotated speech data limit both conventional and modern ASR systems. This paper presents the first critical review of Sinhala ASR research, tracing its development from Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) through deep neural networks to self-supervised pre-trained models such as wav2vec 2.0, XLS-R, Whisper and Massively Multilingual Speech (MMS). We compare existing Sinhala systems with related low-resource ASR work on Tamil, Malayalam and Hindi in terms of architecture, training data, word error rate (WER) and robustness to real-world acoustic conditions, and we assess self-supervised and transfer learning as responses to scarce labeled data. We show that most reported WERs are not directly comparable because they differ in corpus, data split and scoring, and that the only controlled comparison in the literature attributes an 18.1% relative WER reduction to corpus correction alone. We also discuss context-aware ASR that draws on phonological, syntactic and semantic knowledge. We identify six research gaps: (1) the lack of large annotated corpora covering multiple dialects and acoustic conditions; (2) weak contextual modeling of Sinhala morphosyntax; (3) high WER in real-world conditions; (4) the absence of standardized benchmarks; (5) the lack of parameter-efficient fine-tuning studies; and (6) the absence of annotated code-switched Sinhala-English speech resources. We outline a research agenda to address these gaps, intended as a roadmap for researchers working on Sinhala and other morphologically rich languages.
2610.05681.paper_summary_zh: 自動語音識別（ASR）對於低資源語言仍然是一個主要挑戰。<lb/>僧伽羅語是斯里蘭卡的主要語言，約有1600萬使用者，這突顯了困難：黏著語形態學、54音素的音位庫、主語-賓語-動詞（SOV）語法以及稀少的標註語音數據限制了傳統和現代的ASR系統。<lb/>本文呈現了對僧伽羅語ASR研究的首次關鍵回顧，追溯其從隱馬可夫模型（HMM）到深度神經網絡，再到自我監督的預訓練模型，如wav2vec 2.0、XLS-R、Whisper和大規模多語言語音（MMS）的發展。<lb/>我們將現有的僧伽羅語系統與相關的低資源ASR工作（如泰米爾語、馬拉雅拉姆語和印地語）進行比較，從架構、訓練數據、詞錯誤率（WER）和對現實世界聲學條件的穩健性等方面進行評估，並評估自我監督和轉移學習作為應對稀少標註數據的解決方案。<lb/>我們顯示，大多數報告的WER並不直接可比，因為它們在語料庫、數據劃分和評分上存在差異，而文獻中唯一的受控比較將18.1%的相對WER減少歸因於語料庫修正。<lb/>我們還討論了基於語音學、句法和語義知識的上下文感知ASR。<lb/>我們確定了六個研究空白：（1）缺乏涵蓋多種方言和聲學條件的大型標註語料；（2）僧伽羅語形態句法的上下文建模薄弱；（3）現實世界條件下的高WER；（4）缺乏標準化的基準；（5）缺乏參數高效的微調研究；以及（6）缺乏標註的代碼切換僧伽羅語-英語語音資源。<lb/>我們概述了一個研究議程，以解決這些空白，旨在為從事僧伽羅語和其他形態豐富語言的研究人員提供一個路線圖。
